title: Speech and Language Therapist, Autism School
summary: Help pupils aged 7 to 16 with autism build communication and regulation skills at a modern specialist school.
body:
## The position

Our client is a specialist autism school that opened in 2023 and is part of a highly respected special education trust. It offers a personalised, therapeutic curriculum focused on communication, independence and preparation for adulthood, in a purpose-built environment with a dedicated multidisciplinary team.

You'll support pupils aged 7 to 16 with autism and EHCPs, helping them develop vital communication, emotional regulation and social interaction skills. You'll deliver individual and group interventions alongside teaching staff, therapists and support teams, so every pupil can access a personalised, meaningful education.

## The role

- Deliver speech and language therapy assessments, interventions and reviews.
- Support pupils' communication, social interaction and emotional regulation.
- Work collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Contribute to EHCP targets, reports and reviews.
- Provide guidance and training so education staff embed communication strategies.
- Help develop a communication-rich learning environment.

## About you

- An HCPC registered speech and language therapist.
- Passionate about supporting autistic children and young people.
- Organised, proactive and solution-focused.
- Confident delivering individual and group interventions.
- A strong communicator and collaborative team member.
- Resilient, positive and adaptable.

Experience in SEND, autism or school settings is desirable but not essential. Newly qualified therapists with the right attitude are encouraged to apply.

## What's on offer

- Term-time working for an excellent work-life balance.
- A supportive, collaborative multidisciplinary team.
- Purpose-built specialist facilities.
- Ongoing professional development and training.
- The opportunity to make a meaningful, lasting impact.
